Maya R: Quick threadwe need a crisp decision for the retention sprint: how do we handle keystore proof export + legal-hold semantics for the upcoming enterprise pilot?
Jordan P: Raw ask: customers expect 7y for key proofs; product needs to say whether we export proofs to customer buckets or keep them in our tamper-evident archive.
Samir: Opsable pattern: keep canonical proofs in our archive for 7y, offer on-demand export to customer-controlled encrypted bucket (opt-in). Export job signs manifest and logs checksum.
Kevin: Implementation constraints: HSM vendor only emits daily bundles. Export flow = collect bundles -> verify -> sign with custody-key -> push to customer bucket. Dev estimate: 4d + 2 QA.
Priya (Security): Security reqs: envelope encrypt using customer's CMK if provided, else our CMK; include signed manifest and per-bundle audit entry. Also rotate custody key annually and record rotation in manifest.
Ina (Legal): Draft customer-facing language: "Cryptographic proofs retained 7 years in a tamper-evident archive. Customers may request export to their own encrypted storage. Legal hold will prevent deletion or export release until removed by authorized admin." Need to ensure "tamper-evident" is qualified: include signature/checksum and timestamp source.
Maya R: Good. Question: should legal-hold be region-scoped or global?
Ina (Legal): Global is simplest for auditors. UI can allow region filter but hold applies globally to the customer's artifacts. Must record who set it, when, and reason.
Jordan P: Proposed launch criteria (minimal): PRD updated with artifact map + customer copy; export prototype in staging; legal-hold API + audit trail in staging; security checklist done; cost delta calc.
Samir: I'll draft runbook: export cadence, idempotency, rollback, manual release flow for legal-hold with 2-person approval.
Kevin: I'll spin up a spike branch for export + custody signing. Will log estimates in ticket.
Priya (Security): I'll produce checklist for CMK handling and manifest format.
Ina (Legal): I'll review PRD wording once Jordan posts it.

Maya R: Action owners: Jordan (PRD + customer copy), Kevin (export spike), Samir (runbook + cost), Priya (security checklist), Ina (legal signoff). Target: spike + PRD by end of next week.
Jordan P: Will post PRD link here when done. :thumbsup:
Maya R: Thanks all, closing thread.
